_comment: The two films, as data rather than as a document.
One file is the source for BOTH the narration and the camera. The voice is
generated from `say`, and the recorder walks the same list in the same
order, holding each shot for exactly as long as that line takes to speak.
Keeping them apart would mean two scripts drifting out of step, and a film
where the pointer presses Forward while the voice is still on Approvals.
`do` is what the recorder performs. `highlight` is the element the ring is
drawn around while the line is spoken. Both are read by video/record.js.
Voices chosen by the owner on 2026-10-13: en_US-joe-medium (CC0) and
es_ES-davefx-medium (CC0). Both unrestricted - nothing is owed to anybody
for either, which is why they were chosen over better-known voices.

say.en: Jericho is a private market for bulk commodities. There is no public listing, and no way in without an invitation.
say.es: Jericho es un mercado privado de materias primas a granel. No hay anuncios públicos, y no se entra sin invitación.

say.en: Once you are in, everything is on one screen: your offers, the market, and your messages.
say.es: Una vez dentro, todo está en una sola pantalla: sus ofertas, el mercado y sus mensajes.

say.en: To offer something, you fill in one form. Commodity, quantity, Incoterm, origin.
say.es: Para ofrecer algo, se rellena un solo formulario. Materia prima, cantidad, Incoterm y origen.

say.en: Twenty five thousand tonnes of copper cathode, CIF Rotterdam, from Chile. It takes under a minute.
say.es: Veinticinco mil toneladas de cátodo de cobre, CIF Róterdam, desde Chile. Lleva menos de un minuto.

say.en: Your offer appears with its own reference number. You can edit it, renew it, or withdraw it at any time.
say.es: Su oferta aparece con su propio número de referencia. Puede modificarla, renovarla o retirarla cuando quiera.

say.en: Browse shows every offer on the platform. Filter by commodity, or search.
say.es: Explorar muestra todas las ofertas de la Plataforma. Puede filtrar por materia prima o buscar.

say.en: You see the full commercial detail. You do not see who posted it, and they do not see you.
say.es: Ve todo el detalle comercial. No ve quién la publicó, y ellos no le ven a usted.

say.en: Save a search and it becomes a watchlist, telling you how many offers match.
say.es: Guarde una búsqueda y se convierte en una lista de seguimiento que le indica cuántas ofertas coinciden.

say.en: When something interests you, you write to the Operator. Never to the other member.
say.es: Cuando algo le interesa, escribe al Operador. Nunca al otro miembro.

say.en: The Operator reads it, decides, and passes it on. Nothing travels on its own.
say.es: El Operador lo lee, decide, y lo transmite. Nada viaja por su cuenta.

say.en: Replies come back the same way, into your mailbox.
say.es: Las respuestas vuelven por el mismo camino, a su buzón.

say.en: You declare which papers you hold. Nothing is ever uploaded — the platform stores no files.
say.es: Usted declara qué documentos posee. Nunca se sube nada: la Plataforma no almacena archivos.

say.en: The whole platform speaks Spanish as well, at one press.
say.es: La Plataforma también habla inglés, con una sola pulsación.

say.en: Nobody learns who you are until you decide they should. That is the whole point of Jericho.
say.es: Nadie sabe quién es usted hasta que usted decide que lo sepan. Esa es la razón de ser de Jericho.
